 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    edge_colors = {grid[0][c] for c in range(w)} | {grid[h-1][c] for c in range(w)} | {grid[r][0] for r in range(h)} | {grid[r][w-1] for r in range(h)}
    marker = next(v for v in cnt if v != bg and v not in edge_colors)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find the two long runs of the same frame color on opposing vertical edges.
    def get_runs(edge):
        ans=[]; i=0
        while i<h:
            if edge[i] == bg:
                i+=1; continue
            color=edge[i]; j=i+1
            while j<h and edge[j]==color: j+=1
            if j-i>1: ans.append((color,i,j))
            i=j
        return ans
    left=get_runs([grid[r][0] for r in range(h)])
    right=get_runs([grid[r][w-1] for r in range(h)])
    pairs=[(a,b) for a in left for b in right if a[0]==b[0] and a[2]-a[1]==b[2]-b[1]]
    if not pairs:
        return out
    (color,la,lb),(color,ra,rb)=pairs[0]
    # Each marker in one frame segment projects toward that same edge and
    # activates the corresponding offset row in the opposite frame segment.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(1,w-1):
            if grid[r][c] != marker: continue
            if la <= r < lb:
                off=r-la
                out[r][c]=4
                for x in range(1,c): out[r][x]=marker
                rr=ra+off
                for x in range(1,w-1): out[rr][x]=marker
            elif ra <= r < rb:
                off=r-ra
                out[r][c]=4
                for x in range(c+1,w-1): out[r][x]=marker
                rr=la+off
                for x in range(1,w-1): out[rr][x]=marker
    return out
"
}

    def runs(vals):
        a=[];i=0
        while i<len(vals):
            if vals[i]==bg:i+=1;continue
            col=vals[i];j=i+1
            while j<len(vals) and vals[j]==col:j+=1
            if j-i>1:a.append((col,i,j))
            i=j
        return a
    L=runs([grid[r][0] for r in range(h)])
    R=runs([grid[r][w-1] for r in range(h)])
    pairs=[(a,b) for a in L for b in R if a[0]==b[0] and a[2]-a[1]==b[2]-b[1]]
    if not pairs:return out
    (col,la,lb),(col,ra,rb)=pairs[0]
